title: Prepare typed contract fields
responsibility: Prepares declared callable contracts and shared type fields with honest examples and source gaps.

inputs.name: typeLabel.type
inputs.description: A public type expression that may contain an inferred module import.

inputs.name: fieldOf.item
inputs.description: Declared input, output or error item whose type, explanation and examples are presented.

inputs.name: fieldOf.unit
inputs.description: Selected unit supplying callable identity and source context for the contract field.

inputs.name: contractFields.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose contract fields and declared JSON examples will be displayed.

inputs.name: contractFields.category
inputs.description: The entity category; configs provide values and Types show source-declared interfaces and aliases.

inputs.name: contractFacts.rows
inputs.description: Prepared readable contract rows, including facts beyond individual fields.

inputs.name: contractFacts.unit
inputs.description: The entity whose execution targets may be listed as contract facts.

inputs.name: contractFacts.category
inputs.description: The entity category; functions also expose execution targets.

inputs.name: callableContracts.unit
inputs.description: Source-derived callable metadata and declared examples at the selected revision.

inputs.name: returnField.declared
inputs.description: Optional authored return item; absent declarations retain an explicit source-derived gap.

inputs.name: returnField.type
inputs.description: Source-declared return type to display and use for illustrative value shapes.

inputs.name: returnField.callable
inputs.description: Canonical callable name used to identify this return field.

inputs.name: returnField.unit
inputs.description: Selected-revision unit supplying contract documentation and identity.

inputs.name: guess.type
inputs.description: Type expression for which a bounded illustrative value may be constructed.

inputs.name: guess.depth
inputs.description: Current recursion depth limiting nested illustrative type expansion.

outputs.name: typeLabel
outputs.description: The type expression with inferred import paths removed.

outputs.name: contractFields
outputs.description: Typed input/output groups and declared errors or an explicit absence message; shared types retain source fields and optionality without invented defaults.

outputs.name: contractFacts
outputs.description: Whole-contract facts without duplicate field summaries, plus execution targets for functions.

outputs.name: callableContracts
outputs.type: { name: string; signature: string; groups: ContractGroup[] }[]
outputs.description: Literal callable parameters with requirement/default metadata, named return values and declared errors or an explicit No errors declared message.

outputs.name: fieldOf
outputs.description: A readable field preserving requiredness, own literal defaults and authored or illustrative examples.

outputs.name: returnField
outputs.description: A declared return value with its literal name and public type, or an explicit void return.

outputs.name: guess
outputs.description: A bounded illustrative plain-data value when its type can be represented; otherwise JavaScript undefined.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: An authored example contains BigInt or circular data that JSON cannot serialize.

errors.name: RangeError
errors.description: Deeply nested authored examples exceed the JSON serializer stack.

errors.name: Getter, proxy or conversion error
errors.description: Errors from supplied field/default/example getters, proxy traps or JSON conversion methods propagate.
